scope: 20 additional targeted original-source checks in contradictory evidence inventory; no formal full appraisal. Preserve all existing holds.

checks.findings: USDA dietary guidelines systematic review; eight prenatal-only RCTs all reported at least one nonsignificant endpoint, despite selected favorable results. Funding-source employees participated in design, execution, analysis, writing and publication decisions. Separate primary outcomes and multiplicity; no general cognitive improvement promise. Full underlying trial disclosure/overlap review pending.

checks.findings: VDAART six-year follow-up found no reduction in asthma/recurrent wheeze from prenatal intervention alone. NHLBI funding, NCT00920621. Same cohort as CS5-016; not independent replication. Sponsor role at six-year report and complete disclosures pending.

checks.findings: GRoW Australian double-blind placebo RCT, metformin added to lifestyle advice in overweight/obese pregnancy did not improve birth or pregnancy outcomes. NHMRC funding listed. Full author interests, sponsor role and harms pending; do not generalize to diabetes treatment.

checks.findings: Pessary-versus-progesterone systematic review found no clinical advantage for pessary in short-cervix singleton pregnancy. Review funding, exact eligibility, pooled estimates and membership overlap with CS5-009 and earlier trials pending; not independent primary evidence.

checks.findings: Meta-analysis of probiotics in established GDM reported improvements in selected glycemic markers and neonatal outcomes, with varying GRADE certainty. checks.findings: Identity confirmed as 2023 review of progesterone, cerclage, pessary and aspirin in singleton and multifetal pregnancy. Original abstract inspected for scope only; detailed result, funding and trial membership extraction remains pending. No pooling across risk groups.

checks.findings: VDAART double-blind RCT, 881 randomized, child outcome data available for 806; 6.1 percentage-point lower incidence of asthma/recurrent wheeze at age three did not reach statistical significance. NHLBI U01HL091528 and NCATS U54TR001012. NHLBI monitored conduct and selected DSMB; DSMB reviewed manuscript, otherwise sponsor declared no role. Authors disclosed pharmaceutical and publisher relationships. Protocol analysis change approved before unblinding; incomplete follow-up and multiple exploratory secondary outcomes require formal appraisal. Same cohort as CS5-011.

checks.findings: 2025 review: asthma RR 0.94 (0.67–1.31), wheeze 0.82 (0.62–1.09); no significant effect. Asthma heterogeneity substantial. Compare VDAART and other constituent trials, not independent replication. Funding and sponsor disclosure unresolved.
